
#QTI in HPV-I cases by PDL1

```{r}
library(coxphf)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(immunedeconv)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(survminer)
library(stringr)
library(edgeR)
```




```{r}
# convert to matrix (important for many bioinformatics tools)
counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts_HPV_Independent)

# remove duplicated gene symbols if any
counts_mat <- counts_mat[!duplicated(rownames(counts_mat)), ]

# create edgeR object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts_mat)

# TMM normalization (library size normalization)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

# CPM expression matrix
cpm_mat <- cpm(dge, log = FALSE)
```


```{r}
qti <- deconvolute(cpm_mat, "quantiseq")
length(qti$cell_type)


qti_long <- qti %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -cell_type, # All columns except `cell_type`
    names_to = "Sample", 
    values_to = "Fraction"
  )

analysis_data <- qti_long %>%
  left_join(TP53status_clinical, by = c( "Sample"="id"))
```



```{r}
length(unique(analysis_data$cell_type))
# we have 11 cell types

unique(analysis_data$cell_type)
# [1] "B cell"                       "Macrophage M1"               
# [3] "Macrophage M2"                "Monocyte"                    
# [5] "Neutrophil"                   "NK cell"                     
# [7] "T cell CD4+ (non-regulatory)" "T cell CD8+"                 
# [9] "T cell regulatory (Tregs)"    "Myeloid dendritic cell"      
#[11] "uncharacterized cell" 

analysis_data %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    prevalence = mean(Fraction > 0.01),
    median = median(Fraction),
    mean = mean(Fraction)
  ) %>%
  arrange(prevalence)
```




```{r}
filtered_cell_types <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    prevalence = mean(Fraction > 0.01),
    median_value = median(Fraction)
  ) %>%
  filter(prevalence >= 0.10) %>%
  pull(cell_type)

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% filtered_cell_types)

length(unique(analysis_data$cell_type))
#10 cell types we keep

unique(analysis_data$cell_type)
# [1] "B cell"                       "Macrophage M1"                "Macrophage M2"               
# [4] "Neutrophil"                   "NK cell"                      "T cell CD4+ (non-regulatory)"
# [7] "T cell CD8+"                  "T cell regulatory (Tregs)"    "Myeloid dendritic cell"      
#[10] "uncharacterized cell" 
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)


# ============================================================
# 0. Prepare PDL1 status (drop "Unknown", set factor levels)
# ============================================================

analysis_data_pdl1 <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category = factor(
      pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category,
      levels = c("Negative", "Positive")
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 1. Wilcoxon test per cell type + BH-FDR correction
#    (mirrors `results_hpv` / the corrected `results_p53`)
# ============================================================

results_pdl1 <- analysis_data_pdl1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category), !is.na(Fraction)) %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_negative = sum(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Negative"),
    n_positive = sum(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Positive"),
    p_value    = wilcox.test(Fraction ~ pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category)$p.value,
    median_negative = median(Fraction[pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Negative"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_positive = median(Fraction[pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Positive"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across ALL quanTIseq cell types tested
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

# View all results
results_pdl1


# ============================================================
# 2. Keep only FDR-significant cell types
# ============================================================

significant_results <- results_pdl1 %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05)

significant_cell_types <- significant_results$cell_type

significant_data <- analysis_data_pdl1 %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% significant_cell_types) %>%
  left_join(
    significant_results %>%
      select(cell_type, p_value, FDR, median_negative, median_positive),
    by = "cell_type"
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Boxplot/jitter panel of FDR-significant cell types
#    (guarded: quanTIseq has few features, so this may
#    legitimately come back empty after correction)
# ============================================================

if (length(significant_cell_types) == 0) {

  message("No quanTIseq cell types reached FDR < 0.05 for PDL1 status within HPV-independent tumors.")

} else {

  analysis_data_significant <- analysis_data_pdl1 %>%
    filter(
      cell_type %in% significant_cell_types,
      !is.na(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category),
      !is.na(Fraction)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = significant_cell_types),
      pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category = factor(
        pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category,
        levels = c("Negative", "Positive")
      )
    )

  # Check how many observations each cell type has
  print(table(analysis_data_significant$cell_type))

  plot_labels <- significant_results %>%
    mutate(
      cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = significant_cell_types),
      FDR_label = paste0("FDR = ", format.pval(FDR, digits = 2, eps = 0.001))
    )

  qti_PDL1plot <- ggplot(
    analysis_data_significant,
    aes(x = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category, y = Fraction, fill = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category)
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category),
      width = 0.08,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~cell_type,
      scales = "free_y",
      nrow = 2,
      ncol = 4
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = plot_labels,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = FDR_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Negative" = "skyblue1", "Positive" = "skyblue4")
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Negative" = "dodgerblue3", "Positive" = "darkblue")
    ) +

    theme_minimal() +

    labs(
      title = "quanTIseq Cell Type Fractions by PDL1 Status (HPV-independent)",
      x = "PDL1 Immune Cells Status",
      y = "quanTIseq Fraction",
      fill = "PDL1 Status",
      color = "PDL1 Status"
    ) +

    theme(
      panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10))

  print(qti_PDL1plot)
}
```
